name: RFdiffusion3 (RFD3)
summary: Foundry atom-level generative design of protein structures and binders.

steps: Read the current official RFdiffusion3 installation tutorial and separate it from legacy RFdiffusion and RFdiffusion2.
Create a fresh environment with compatible Python/PyTorch/GPU support and follow the documented rc-foundry[rfd3] package route.
Confirm the user's preferred checkpoint directory and download size before using foundry install rfd3; never silently download weights into a shared home directory.
install.verify_note: Check the Foundry/RFD3 CLI and checkpoint path. The official design demo performs compute and is a separately approved test.

notes: The official tutorial describes an approximately 3 GB model checkpoint. GPU architecture and PyTorch compatibility need per-host review.
